title: Carleman estimates for backward Cahn-Hilliard-reaction-diffusion problems
summary: We study a backward inverse problem for a coupled Cahn-Hilliard-reaction-diffusion system. Our main result is a Carleman estimate for a fourth-order/second-order parabolic system with cross-diffusion terms, which allows us to derive conditional stability estimates for the reconstruction of past states from a single final-time observation: Hölder stability at positive times and logarithmic stability for the initial datum.
